title: Moonglow persisted settings
description: Canonical on-disk settings shape shared by every platform. Keys are camelCase. Decoding is lenient: a missing or malformed value falls back to its default instead of failing the whole load, so every property is optional here even though writers emit all of them.

dayColorTempK.description: Cooler end of the schedule window: the daytime target.

nightColorTempK.description: Warmer end of the schedule window: the night target.

morningStart.description: Start of the morning warm-to-cool transition.

morningEnd.description: End of the morning transition; the day target takes over here.

eveningStart.description: Start of the evening cool-to-warm transition.

eveningEnd.description: End of the evening transition; the night target takes over here.

autoColorTemperature.description: Whether the schedule drives colour temperature. When false the manual target is used.

manualColorTempK.description: Colour temperature used while automatic scheduling is off.

launchAtLogin.description: User intent only. The real registration lives in the OS and is re-asserted at launch rather than trusted.

increaseBrightnessShortcut.description: macOS only. Absent on platforms without global hot keys.

decreaseBrightnessShortcut.description: macOS only. Absent on platforms without global hot keys.

increaseTemperatureShortcut.description: macOS only. Absent on platforms without global hot keys.

decreaseTemperatureShortcut.description: macOS only. Absent on platforms without global hot keys.

timeOfDay.description: Zero-padded 24-hour wall-clock time, independent of date and time zone.

modifiers.description: Carbon modifier bits: command 0x100, shift 0x200, option 0x800, control 0x1000. Zero is invalid and is dropped on load.
